text:
Marshmallow Creamy Caramel Sauce 

Serves: 10

Total time: 10 min Prep time: 5 min 





1 1/2 cups corn syrup 
3/4 cup white sugar 
1 lb brown sugar 
8 marshmallows 
1/2 cup butter 
1 1/2 cups evaporated milkted milk 
1/2 tsp vanilla 
1 pinch salt 

1 In small saucepan, boil sugar and syrup.
2 Stir occasionally on medium heat to soft boil (240 degrees).
3 Remove from heat.
4 Add marshmallows and butter.
5 Cool to taste and stir in milk.
